name: Akehoshi Chiemi
source:
Playful, energetic and friendly, Chiemi grew in a big family, and being the only girl among the children, she always played boys games, that made Chiemi a somewhat tomboyish. Despite being a Cast, she didn't receive any bullying nor special treatment, probably because of how friendly she is. Because people always said she wasn't feminine she never had interest in love and never believed someone would ever fall for her. She's always being challenged to duels to help clubs in need as she is very athletic and talented.

Chiemi is always upfront about things and her catchphrase is "I rather doing it than not doing and regret it". When she realizes she fell in love with the protagonist she immediately confesses to him. 

Her Cast is Alice Card. She picks a card in a deck of 54 cards, with 2 jokers, wich she only drew once. The card suit will define the weapon: Swords become swords, Clubs become a gauntlet, Diamonds become a spear and Hearts become a bow. The card's number define the weapon strength or, in the bow case, the number of arrows shot at once. She needs to use the same card for 3 minutes, after that the weapon disappears, regardless of her wish and she may then draw another card.

Her powers are inspired from Alice in Wonderland, and she's a Princess Level cast, but she loses a lot because she's dependent on luck.
